parameters.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id FROM governance.missions WHERE mission_key = '{{$json.mission_key}}'
), r AS (
  SELECT id AS repo_id FROM governance.repositories WHERE repo_key = '{{$json.repo_key}}'
), mt AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_task_id, mission_id, repo_id
  FROM governance.mission_tasks
  WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m)
    AND repo_id = (SELECT repo_id FROM r)
    AND assigned_agent = '{{$json.agent_id}}'
    AND status IN ('in_progress','pending')
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'in_progress' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO governance.reports (mission_task_id, repo_id, head_sha, report_hash, report_payload, ingest_status, submitted_by, source_env)
  SELECT mt.mission_task_id, mt.repo_id, '{{$json.head_sha}}', '{{$json.content_hash}}',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'mission_key', '{{$json.mission_key}}',
           'repo_key', '{{$json.repo_key}}',
           'agent_id', '{{$json.agent_id}}',
           'branch', '{{$json.branch}}',
           'report_md', {{$json.report_md_sql}}
         ),
         'accepted',
         '{{$json.agent_id}}',
         'n8n-phase1'
  FROM mt
  ON CONFLICT (mission_task_id, head_sha) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mission_id FROM mt) AS mission_id,
  (SELECT mission_task_id FROM mt) AS mission_task_id,
  (SELECT repo_id FROM mt) AS repo_id,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) THEN false ELSE true END AS duplicate_ignored;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT id AS mission_id FROM governance.missions WHERE mission_key = '{{$node["Validar + Autenticacao + Hash"].json["mission_key"]}}'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mission_id FROM m) AS mission_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m)) AS total_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance.mission_tasks WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM m) AND status = 'completed') AS done_tasks,
  false AS all_done;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status:'ok', mission_id:$node['Validar + Autenticacao + Hash'].json.mission_key, event_hash:$node['Validar + Autenticacao + Hash'].json.content_hash, next_action:'snapshot_update' } }}
